verdict.rationale: Sierra advertises an official "Agent SDK" for writing customer journeys as code with logic traces and testing (sierra-docs-1/2/4), but runtime probes show no public OpenAPI/swagger spec and the SDK/docs reference is login-gated to contracted customers rather than openly available to any AI-native developer (sierra-probe-2, sierra-probe-rt-3). Missing for 10: publicly accessible API reference/OpenAPI spec, evidence of open sign-up or trial SDK access, and independent developer accounts of building against it outside a paid contract.
